answer_1.quote: For the given molecule, the goal of molecule captioning task is to provide a description of the given molecule. This is a reverse task of molecule captioning. Given the nature language description of the intended molecule, the goal is to generate the molecule that fits the description.
answer_1.outputs: text descriptions of molecules and molecular structures from text descriptions

answer_2.quote: NLP metrics like BLEU, ROUGE, and METEOR are utilized to evaluate the closeness of the generated description to the ground truth description. We also adopt Text2Mol metric, which is proposed by Edwards et al. ( ) and employ pre-trained models to measure the similarity between the description and ground truth molecule.
